name: Nothing Left
source:
A journey that follows a lost mind trapped in repetition. Waking up to the same day over and over, where memories blur with dreams of a past that refuses to go.

[From [url=https://molotzx.itch.io/nothing-left]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段追寻陷入重复的迷失心灵的旅程。一遍又一遍地在同一天醒来，记忆因无法忘记的过去的梦想而变得模糊。

[来自[url=https://molotzx.itch.io/nothing-left]Itch.io[/url]]
